prompts.object: Editorial still life photograph of a hand-built tabletop model made of paper, card, matte ceramic and brushed steel, photographed as a physical object on a plain pale surface, soft north-window light with long gentle shadows, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, matte film grade with lifted whites. Side view of a row of wooden six-sided hexagonal blocks growing from small to large from left to right, each block a successive cycle, the last and largest block set slightly apart from the row. Subject centred with a quiet margin around it. Color palette: crisp white and pale mist-blue surfaces, deep blue and slate, soft grey. There is exactly one amber object in the frame: the last and largest block, in amber glass. All other objects are white, grey, blue or slate. No text, no logos, no writing.
prompts.figure: Editorial documentary photograph of a calm working session around a hand-built tabletop model made of paper, card, matte ceramic and brushed steel, soft north-window daylight, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, matte film grade with lifted whites. Close-up at table height. The picture shows only one pair of forearms and hands, in navy and grey knitwear, standing at a long pale table, setting the largest block into place at the end of the row, in front of a row of wooden hexagonal blocks growing from small to large. The top edge of the photograph cuts through the middle of the torso, well below the collar. Subject centred with a quiet margin around it. Color palette: crisp white and pale mist-blue surfaces, deep blue and slate, soft grey. There is exactly one amber object in the frame: the largest block of the row in amber glass. All other objects are white, grey, blue or slate. No text, no logos, no writing.
